# [NordVPN](https://go.nordvpn.net/yourcode) vs ExpressVPN Comparison 2026

Choosing between **NordVPN vs ExpressVPN** is one of the biggest debates in the VPN world right now. Both are premium VPN services that promise to keep your online activity private, secure, and unrestricted — but they take noticeably different approaches to get the job done. In this head-to-head comparison, we'll break down everything you need to know so you can pick the right one for your needs in 2026.

## Overview of Both VPNs

### NordVPN at a Glance

NordVPN has been around since 2012 and is based in Panama, a country with no mandatory data retention laws. Over the years, it has grown into one of the most popular VPN providers on the planet, boasting over 6,000 servers across 111 countries. NordVPN has invested heavily in its proprietary NordLynx protocol, built around WireGuard, which delivers impressive speeds while maintaining strong security. The company also completed multiple independent audits, giving users extra confidence in its no-logs claims.

### ExpressVPN at a Glance

ExpressVPN launched in 2011 and is headquartered in the British Virgin Islands — another privacy-friendly jurisdiction. It operates servers in 105 countries and has built a reputation for being incredibly user-friendly and reliable. ExpressVPN developed its own Lightway protocol from scratch, designed to be lightweight, fast, and secure. The service has also undergone numerous third-party audits, including security assessments of its server infrastructure and software. ExpressVPN was acquired by Kape Technologies (now rebranded as "The Kape Group"), which raised some eyebrows in the privacy community, though the service's track record remains solid.

## Speed and Performance

### NordVPN Speed Test Results

NordVPN's adoption of the NordLynx protocol has been a game-changer for performance. In recent independent tests, NordVPN consistently delivers download speeds that retain roughly 85-92% of your base connection speed. The WireGuard foundation makes it one of the fastest VPNs available, and the large server network means you're less likely to encounter overcrowded servers. During peak hours, NordVPN holds up remarkably well, with minimal latency spikes.

### ExpressVPN Speed Test Results

ExpressVPN's Lightway protocol is engineered for speed and efficiency. Tests show it maintaining around 87-93% of base speeds, which puts it slightly ahead in raw throughput in some scenarios. ExpressVPN's network is smaller in total server count, but the quality of its server infrastructure is excellent. Latency tends to be low, making it a strong choice for real-time applications like video calls and online gaming.

### Which Is Faster?

In most real-world scenarios, the speed difference between these two VPNs is marginal. Both are fast enough for streaming in 4K, large downloads, and competitive gaming. Your experience will depend more on your base internet speed, the server you connect to, and network conditions on any given day.

## Security and Privacy Features

### NordVPN Security Features

NordVPN offers AES-256 encryption, a kill switch, and specialty servers including Double VPN (which routes traffic through two servers) and Onion Over VPN servers. The Threat Protection feature blocks ads, trackers, and malicious websites even before you connect to a VPN. NordVPN also offers a dedicated IP option and Meshnet for creating encrypted private networks between devices. Its no-logs policy has been verified by multiple independent audits.

### ExpressVPN Security Features

ExpressVPN uses AES-256 encryption and its own proprietary Lightway protocol, which has been audited for security. The service includes a kill switch, split tunneling, and a unique feature called "Server Faking" — ExpressVPN servers run entirely on RAM, meaning no data is ever written to a hard drive. This "TrustedServer" approach means every reboot wipes all data clean. ExpressVPN also offers a password manager (Keys) as an add-on feature.

### Privacy Comparison

Both companies operate under jurisdictions without mandatory data retention laws. NordVPN is based in Panama; ExpressVPN in the British Virgin Islands. Both have proven their no-logs claims through independent audits. However, ExpressVPN's acquisition by Kape Technologies introduced some trust concerns for privacy purists, even though no evidence of data mishandling has surfaced. NordVPN has maintained its independent status, which some users view as a privacy advantage.

## Streaming and Geo-Unblocking

### NordVPN for Streaming

NordVPN excels at unblocking streaming platforms. It reliably accesses Netflix libraries in the US, UK, Japan, and several other regions. The service also works well with Disney+, Hulu, BBC iPlayer, Amazon Prime Video, and HBO Max. NordVPN's SmartPlay technology automatically optimizes connections for streaming, so you rarely need to fiddle with settings.

### ExpressVPN for Streaming

ExpressVPN has long been considered the gold standard for streaming access. It unblocks virtually every major platform, including Netflix, Disney+, BBC iPlayer, and regional services that many other VPNs struggle with. ExpressVPN's MediaStreamer DNS feature also helps on devices that don't natively support VPN apps, like smart TVs and gaming consoles.

### Streaming Winner

Both VPNs are excellent for streaming, but ExpressVPN has a slight edge in consistency. Some streaming platforms actively target VPN IP addresses, and ExpressVPN tends to rotate and refresh its IP pool more aggressively, resulting in fewer blocked connections.

## Pricing and Plans

### NordVPN Pricing

NordVPN offers three tiers: Standard, Plus, and Complete. The Standard plan starts at around $3.39/month on a 2-year plan. The Plus tier adds a password manager and data breach scanner, while Complete adds encrypted cloud storage. Monthly plans are significantly more expensive, around $12.99/month. NordVPN frequently runs promotions, making long-term plans very affordable.

### ExpressVPN Pricing

ExpressVPN is pricier. Plans start at approximately $6.67/month on a 15-month commitment, with monthly plans around $12.95/month. There are no tiered plans — you get the full feature set on every subscription. ExpressVPN doesn't run as many aggressive promotions, so pricing stays relatively consistent year-round.

### Value for Money

NordVPN offers better value, especially on long-term plans. The lower price point combined with a broader feature set (including Double VPN, Threat Protection, and Meshnet) makes it the more economical choice. ExpressVPN justifies its premium with exceptional reliability and simplicity, but budget-conscious users will lean toward NordVPN.

## Device Compatibility and Apps

### NordVPN App Experience

NordVPN offers apps for Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, Android TV, and browser extensions for Chrome, Firefox, and Edge. The interface is clean and modern, with a map-based server selection that's intuitive. You can connect up to 10 devices simultaneously. The Linux app is a genuine GUI application, which is a nice touch for that user base.
